test_title: PYST 42: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence that has a grammatical error.

options.text: The company came up with a brilliant marketing strategy.
She always comes down with a cold in winter.
He came across an interesting article while researching.
We came in the meeting room quietly.

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. We came in the meeting room quietly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "We came in the meeting room quietly" contains a grammatical error in the use of the preposition **"in."**
 
• In this context, the correct preposition to use is **"into,"** because the action involves movement from outside to inside the meeting room.
 
• The corrected sentence should be: *"We came **into** the meeting room quietly."*

Correct sentence: *We came **into** the meeting room quietly.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Difference between "in" and "into":**
 
 
• **"In":** Indicates a static position or location (e.g., "She is in the room.").
 
• **"Into":** Indicates movement from one place to another (e.g., "He walked into the room.").
 
 
 
• When describing movement toward a location, always use **"into."**
